blocks.text: A full-day tour of Recife and Olinda. Discover the three historic districts of the centre, Recife, Santo Antônio and Boa Vista: the Maurício de Nassau Bridge, the Praça da República, surrounded by the Governor’s Palace, the Santa Isabel Theatre and the Palace of Justice, and the Casa da Cultura, a 19th-century former prison that is now a centre of regional culture with craft and food shops. Then on to Olinda, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with the Church of Mercy, the São Bento Monastery and the Cathedral of the Sé on the Alto da Sé hill, with a breathtaking view over the sister cities.

blocks.text: Breakfast and transfer to your hotel in Porto de Galinhas, about 60 km south of Recife. This former fishing village is known for its magnificent beaches, among the most beautiful in Brazil: clear turquoise water, white sand and coconut palms along the shore. Time to rest.
